record.body:
## Interfaces

Six independent jobs (checks, test-canon, test-tuner, test-orchestra, test-tmux, types) with no needs. Each installs with uv sync --locked --group dev on Python 3.10 with the uv cache enabled. tests/test_ci_workflow.py parses ci.yml with pyyaml. The README, CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md point to the same four pytest commands that ci.yml and the .canon/config.json suite command use.

## Assumptions

The NoMatches teardown race in the dashboard is real, based on repeated CI failures. main's .canon/config.json carries the four-command suite (mode full, gate advisory).

## Invariants

The four pytest selections match across ci.yml, README and the suite command, except that the CI tmux job adds --reruns 2 (documented). Only the types job sets continue-on-error. tuner-verdict.yml is unchanged. No run step ends with || true.

## Conflicts

None. main's two perf(dashboard) commits merged with one conflict in tests/test_dashboard_model.py, resolved to main's version minus two unused imports.
